data.one_liner: Library for manipulating, converting, and formatting DateTimes in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Instant provides functions and utilities for converting, formatting, and handling dates and times in Dart. It supports timezone manipulation, current and manual date/time displays, and includes a stopwatch alternative.
use_when: You need to format DateTimes easily in Dart.
You require timezone manipulation and conversion.
avoid_when: You need complex internationalization or locale-aware plural rules.
You prefer using standard Dart core DateTime capabilities without external packages.
weaknesses: Very limited documentation on specific functions outside of external Gitbook links
Few recent updates beyond bug fixes
